notes: Researched by Copilot (Opus 4.8) via direct web fetch on 2026-09-21 — no Anthropic API. Every event has a real source link. See research-log.md for source status, gaps, dedupe list and skipped events. Coverage strong for 09-21..10-18 across MUS/GAL/ARCH/QUEER/NEIGH/CHIC/IND; gaps remain in MUSPROD/GAME/TECH/FASH (see log). Long-running exhibitions keep their real start/end and span multiple weeks. genre is only set for cat=MUS.
